items.title: Morgan Stanley (MS) Wealth Narrative Holds Following Preferred Dividend Declaration
items.summary: Morgan Stanley (MS) just declared regular dividends across a wide slate of preferred stock series, setting out specific per share and Depositary Share amounts, along with December and January payment schedules.
